name: Streaming · CS2 tournament overlay platform
description: Tournament overlay stack for Counter-Strike 2: Rust backend, React control desk, OBS overlays, and a single authoritative match state with auditable operator overrides.
longDescription: End-to-end broadcast system for CS2 tournaments. A Rust service ingests game state, maintains one authoritative match model, and streams updates to a React dashboard and HTML overlay scenes for OBS. Operators manage teams, players, themes, and manual overrides with audit history. Optional authentication protects ingest and write routes. Deployed with container compose; an optional desktop shell supports on-site events. Integration tests validate core state and overlay behaviour.
features: Single source of truth for match state shared by dashboard and overlays
Game state ingest with heartbeat and stale detection
Multiple overlay layouts for scoreboard, economy, veto, and lower thirds
Manual overrides with undo stack and audit log
Tournament import and export in structured JSON
Automated integration tests for state and overlay contracts
highlights: One state model feeding both control desk and OBS scenes
Operational tooling for repeatable local and venue deploys
Optional desktop packaging for on-site tournament use
challenges: Live esports overlays must stay in sync while tolerating game crashes and partial game state payloads.
solutions: Central state service, WebSocket delivery, stale indicators, and explicit override tooling with auditability.
security: Optional ingest authentication to reduce spoofed updates on shared networks
Do not expose control APIs to untrusted networks without TLS and access control
Treat overlay URLs as broadcast-readable without embedded operator secrets
